_about: Warm, short milestone lines per language. 'spoken' is plain English (safe for any TTS voice); 'shown' may include native script. Play reactions.json milestone sound first.

_rules.first_letter: the first character graded correct in this language
_rules.first_word: the first item where every character was graded correct in one run
_rules.first_mastered: the first item completed correctly three times (or once from dictation without the animation)
